title: Back Office Administrator

about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, a well-established company within Malta's automotive industry, for an organised and customer-focused Back Office Administrator to join its aftersales team in Gżira.

You will coordinate vehicle service appointments, handle customer enquiries, prepare job cards and keep records accurate in the CRM — making sure the workshop runs smoothly, customers are kept informed about estimates and progress, and invoices, purchase orders and warranty documents are processed correctly.

The role suits someone with strong administrative and communication skills and an interest in the automotive industry. It is full-time and on-site, with a competitive salary, health insurance, an employee benefits card and professional training.
responsibilities: Handle customer enquiries, service bookings and appointment scheduling
Keep customer information accurate and up to date in the CRM system
Prepare job cards and record vehicle and service documentation correctly
Coordinate workshop appointments and allocate jobs according to technician availability and capacity
Communicate with customers on repair estimates, service updates, additional repairs and vehicle collection
Coordinate vehicle recalls and technical campaigns, informing customers and arranging appointments
Monitor repair progress, follow up potential delays and escalate repeat repair concerns
Process invoices, purchase orders, warranty documentation and other administrative records
Handle cash transactions, deposits and credit account invoicing when required
Follow up customer enquiries and leads received through manufacturer systems
Promote service packages and aftersales offers where appropriate
Work with workshop teams and management, following company procedures, health and safety regulations and manufacturer standards
requirements: Basic understanding of motor vehicle components and automotive services
Previous experience in administration, customer service or a similar role is an advantage
Good computer literacy and the ability to work with administrative systems
A customer-focused approach with strong problem-solving skills
Attention to detail and accuracy in documentation
The ability to work in a fast-paced environment, independently and as part of a team
A positive attitude and willingness to learn

A supportive, dynamic working environment and the opportunity to build a career in the automotive industry
skills: Invoicing, purchase orders and cash handling
Customer communication on estimates and repairs
